detail.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Gaps in Open-Ended Learning
detail.summary: Autonomous agents identify research gaps by bridging intrinsic motivation mechanisms, like curiosity-driven learning, with goal-directed self-generation, allowing navigation of unstructured problem spaces.
detail.reason: Synthesize updated understanding of how curiosity and goal-generation drive autonomous exploration.
